userIntent: Continue Bauman Hub after accepted storage r5. Remove raw subject transport/config leakage from learner state and presentation while preserving existing public Hub↔Subject behavior and current storage guarantees.
objective: Implement a Hub-owned subject descriptor/launch abstraction so learner UI and Hub presentation no longer consume mainPath/editorPath directly, remove direct learner editor access, separate application launch configuration from scoped learner data/backup, and preserve public bridge/task/capability behavior without reading or modifying subject internals.
targetArea: Bauman Hub subject descriptors, launch adapter, authoring/editor gating, personal-vs-application configuration ownership, and integration regression

baselinePolicy.rebaseInstruction: Fetch latest main before editing. If main moves, reconcile only impacted allowed Hub/public-contract paths; do not redo accepted storage r5.

knownDefects.summary: Subject launch/editor paths are embedded in state.subjects and therefore travel through scoped learner state and portable learner backup even though they are application/device configuration.
evidence: assets/js/main.js default state constructs state.subjects with mainPath/editorPath.
normalizeState restores saved.mainPath/saved.editorPath from learner state.
Admin UI edits state.subjects[id].mainPath/editorPath and persists with save().
Storage r5 now correctly treats main Hub state as scoped personal learner data, making this ownership mismatch explicit.

knownDefects.summary: Canonical and reference Subjects learner UI exposes a direct 'Dữ liệu môn' action that calls app.openSubjectEditor(), bypassing the public learner capability boundary.
evidence: assets/js/main.js subjectDetailHTML() renders 'Dữ liệu môn' -> app.openSubjectEditor().
assets/js/subjects-reference-v1.js course menus render 'Dữ liệu môn' -> openEditor() -> app.openSubjectEditor().
No explicit public authoring capability is required before these learner-facing actions are shown.

knownDefects.summary: Hub presentation and app actions consume raw mainPath directly for subject launch instead of a transport-independent Launch Adapter.
evidence: The canonical Hub contract requires Descriptor → Capability → Launch Adapter → Normalized Hub Read Model.

knownDefects.summary: Existing admins may have persisted custom mainPath/editorPath overrides inside legacy/personal Hub state; simply deleting those fields would lose configuration or copy it incorrectly across profile scopes.
evidence: Admin UI historically allowed direct path editing.
Storage r5 can now partition learner data by profile, but application launch config should not become one copy per learner scope.

knownDefects.summary: Multiple Hub presentation/decorator layers depend on app.openSubjectInPage and current state.subjects projection; the migration must preserve five-route UX while preventing decorators from becoming transport/config authorities.
evidence: hub-primary-pages-v6 decorates Subjects/Schedule/Research and wraps existing renderers.

architectureInvariants: Hub↔Subject integration remains Descriptor → Capability → Launch Adapter → Normalized Hub Read Model.

Do not read or modify prompts/subjects/** or subjects/** except the single explicitly authorized public Hub-contract validator subjects/russian/scripts/validate-capability-deeplink.mjs. No Subject runtime/private source reads or edits.
Do not invent a subject endpoint or learner capability.
Application launch configuration is not learner progress/evidence and must not live in scoped personal backup after migration.
Learner-facing Subjects UI must not expose direct editor/authoring access unless an explicit registered public authoring capability exists; absence means the action is hidden/unavailable.
Legacy mainPath/editorPath may survive only behind an application-owned compatibility/config adapter during migration.
Existing custom admin launch overrides must be preserved once in application/device config, not duplicated across learner profile scopes.
Existing postMessage origin checks, task handoff, capability request/state and route-receipt contracts must remain intact.
Missing launch descriptor/capability degrades explicitly to UNAVAILABLE; never reverse-engineer subject internals.
Storage r5 invariants remain: learner backup is scoped, credential-free, attachment-safe and portable.
Exactly five primary learner routes remain unchanged.

subjectDescriptorRegistry.purpose: Canonical subject metadata + declared launch configuration independent from learner personal state

launchAdapter.compatibility: Existing app.openSubjectInPage/openSubjectTab may remain temporary wrappers but must delegate to the adapter and must not read raw mainPath themselves.

learnerProjection.personalState: Keep learner-owned choices such as subject priority/selection/progress separately from application launch config.
learnerProjection.backup: No raw mainPath/editorPath in ordinary learner backup after migration.
learnerProjection.runtime: A merged runtime projection may exist for compatibility, but persisted ownership must remain explicit.

authoring.learner: No direct Dữ liệu môn/editor action by default.
authoring.admin: Admin/device configuration may retain an isolated configuration/editor mechanism if needed, but it must not be presented as a learner capability and must not enter learner backup.
authoring.futureCapability: If a public authoring capability is later declared, the Hub may expose it through the same descriptor/capability boundary.

implementationPhases.name: Rebaseline and inventory
work: Fetch latest main and record exact beforeSha.
Verify accepted storage r5 remains intact.
Map every raw mainPath/editorPath reader/writer and every learner launch/editor action in allowed Hub paths.

implementationPhases.name: Descriptor/config ownership split
work: Introduce or consolidate Hub-owned subject descriptor/config authority.
Move canonical launch config out of scoped learner state.
Migrate legacy custom path overrides once into application/device config or an equivalent Hub-owned non-personal compatibility store.
Ensure ordinary learner backup excludes raw launch/editor config.

implementationPhases.name: Generic launch adapter
work: Make app.openSubjectInPage/openSubjectTab delegate to the adapter or replace callers directly.
Preserve URL safety, iframe task handoff, postMessage origin checks, capability state and route receipt behavior.
Return explicit UNAVAILABLE when launch config is missing/invalid.

implementationPhases.name: Learner authoring/editor gating
work: Remove direct learner 'Dữ liệu môn' actions from canonical and reference Subjects surfaces.
Keep any admin/device configuration isolated from learner presentation.
Do not infer authoring capability from existence of editor.html.

implementationPhases.name: Regression and evidence
work: Add static/browser tests for descriptor ownership, adapter launch, missing launch state, learner editor absence and legacy override migration.
Run original Whole System Integration Gate and packaged browser acceptance.
Verify zero changed files under forbidden subject paths.

acceptanceCriteria: Exact latest-main beforeSha and final tested afterSha are recorded.
No runtime/presentation code outside the Hub descriptor/config adapter reads raw mainPath/editorPath for learner launch.
Ordinary scoped learner backup contains no mainPath/editorPath application configuration.
Legacy custom launch overrides are preserved once in Hub application/device config and are not cloned across learner scopes.
Canonical Subjects learner UI contains no direct 'Dữ liệu môn'/openSubjectEditor action by default.
Reference Subjects learner UI contains no direct editor action by default.
No authoring capability is invented from editor path/file existence.
Launch with a valid descriptor works in-Hub and in-tab through the adapter.
Missing/invalid launch config produces explicit UNAVAILABLE/clear UI feedback without reading subject internals.
Schedule launch, Home continue, mentor/search subject launch and reference Subjects launch continue to work.
Iframe/postMessage task handoff and capability request/route receipt remain green.
Storage r5 migration, scoped backup/restore, credential redaction and research attachments remain green.
Exactly five primary learner routes remain unchanged.
No subject-private file/state access is introduced.
No Subject runtime or prompt files are modified; only the explicitly authorized public Hub-contract validator exception may change, with its Subject assertions intact.
Whole System Integration Gate original workflow passes on exact final head.
Release target is LOCAL_STABLE only; production remains NOT_DEPLOYED.
